Stop SQL Rooms Processes

Source: R/launchBrowser.R
stop_sqlrooms.Rd

Stops SQL Rooms background processes started by [launchBrowser()]. This helper stops both the R execution server and the frontend server.

Usage

stop_sqlrooms(dashboard = NULL)

Arguments

dashboard

Optional list returned by [launchBrowser()]. If NULL, stops the most recent SQL Rooms processes tracked in the package environment.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with logical flags: r_server_stopped, frontend_stopped.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
result <- launchBrowser(browser = FALSE)
stop_sqlrooms(result)
} # }
